key_insight: In finite systems, the wavenumber range supporting the Zakharov–Filonenko capillary-wave energy cascade shrinks as average wave steepness decreases, consistent with scaling ∼μ^(8/3).
engineering_relevance: Finite-domain capillary-wave simulations must account for wave steepness when assessing whether a turbulent cascade can be resolved.
method: Numerically simulate capillary-wave turbulence in finite systems.
Vary nonlinearity levels and simulation configurations.
Test cascade-range scaling against average wave steepness μ.
evidence_signal: The simulations confirm the proposed ∼μ^(8/3) scaling and exhibit the Zakharov–Filonenko spectrum over a reported record range close to or beyond one decade.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify numerical resolution or convergence tests, limiting assessment of how robustly finite-system effects are distinguished from numerical constraints.
paper_title: Wave Turbulence of Capillary Waves in Finite Systems
